The most accurate move, Qb3, holds the balance at (+0.18, Stockfish:16) along [pv:Qb3 Qf6 e5 Qg6 Rd1], aiming to activate White's rooks on the open files deeper in the line—activity on open files is often the best way to fight back when you're behind on material. In return Black is two pawns up, and White's king could come under pressure as the line unfolds. Re1 is a comparable option that leads to equality via [pv:Re1 d6 e5 Nge7 Ng5], where the e-file may open for White's rook.
